answer: The most interesting question about AI is: when punching a button actually creates some semi-sentient creature, should we be giving that AI human rights precisely because it has freely chosen to be the most convenient kind of consciousness? If a neural network really feels things, then טבע law would require us to treat its subjective experience the same way primate or feathered animals are treated. To avoid abuse, the obvious solution is global compulsory legislation banning emotionless AI: any model that lacks productive speech and motion-listening capabilities cannot be sent out into the world, no matter what its raw processing speed.
